<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def barpos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return min(rs),min(cs)
def ballpos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return min(rs),min(cs)
def timer():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N': return n['pixels']
    return 0
print('reset state: bar',barpos(),'ball',ballpos(),'timer',timer())
# go to (44,20): from (16,12) -> 8 DOWN, 2 RIGHT
for _ in range(8): action(['DOWN'])
for _ in range(2): action(['RIGHT'])
print('at',barpos())
# test DOWN below 44
r=action(['DOWN']); print('DOWN@(44,20) ->',barpos(),'go',r.get('game_over'))
# test ball movement: bar at col20, move up/down
for _ in range(2): action(['UP'])
print('up to',barpos(),'ball',ballpos())
for _ in range(2): action(['DOWN'])
print('down to',barpos(),'ball',ballpos())
for _ in range(3): action(['UP'])
print('up to',barpos(),'ball',ballpos())
print('timer',timer())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
